description: Implementation of a platform service for handling loan status change events, including registering event listeners and processing status-related actions.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that registers listeners for loan status change events and contains logic to handle such events.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangedListener
classes.description: Listener class that reacts to loan status change events, logging the event and activating maturity date if the loan is open.

classes.name: LoanAccrualActivityPostingLoanStatusChangedListener
classes.description: Listener class that posts accrual activities when a loan is reopened after certain status changes.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for loan status change events after bean construction.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent (LoanStatusChangedListener)
methods.description: Handles the business event indicating a loan's status has changed; activates maturity date if open.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent (LoanAccrualActivityPostingLoanStatusChangedListener)
methods.description: Handles the event for a loan re-opening and processes accrual activities if enabled.
